description: This file is the main React component and routing logic for the frontend of a note-taking application built with Remix. It manages data loaders, actions, and layout rendering.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads the list of notes for the sidebar, returning an empty list on server or when document is undefined. Runs both server-side and client-side due to Remix's data loading.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submissions, particularly creating a new note. Redirects appropriately depending on environment (server or client).

methods.name: links
methods.description: Provides external stylesheet links, mainly for fonts.

methods.name: Layout
methods.description: Defines the main page layout, including head metadata, navigation state handling, and rendering children components within a consistent page structure.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that includes the sidebar and main content area, rendering nested routes via Outlet.
